items: Time difference formula: 1 degree of longitude equals a 4-minute time difference (+4 minutes towards East, -4 minutes towards West).
Standard Meridian of India (82°30' E) passes through Mirzapur, Uttar Pradesh, and is calculated as GMT + 5:30.
The Prime Meridian passing through Greenwich was officially chosen at the International Meridian Conference held in 1884.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Greenwich Mean Time (GMT) is the mean solar time measured at the Royal Observatory in Greenwich, London.
The Prime Meridian, defined as 0° longitude, serves as the universal baseline for calculating global time zones.
Earth rotates 360° in 24 hours, which equates to a 15° change in longitude per hour or 4 minutes per degree.
Indian Standard Time (IST) is based on the 82.5° E longitude meridian and is 5 hours and 30 minutes ahead of GMT.
Places located east of the Prime Meridian gain time relative to GMT, while places west of it lose time.
